patch.value: 2026-07-26 agent-context readiness audit: full CLI, SDK, and ecosystem review and optimization plan

Tracker-only manual audit of the complete pm CLI, public pm SDK, repository architecture, agent UX, performance, security, code quality, tests, docs, skills, bundled packages, and external pm packages on current main (2026.7.26, 2,066 items). This plan records findings and sequencing only; no product implementation belongs in this session. Pass identifier follows decision pm-zeifd2 (ISO date + theme, never sequential numbers). Predecessor plan: pm-45lr (closed). Duplicate check: searched audit/plan/review items all-status; canonical owners absorb every broad theme (pm-n7rr CLI grammar, pm-usfg SDK-first, pm-9rxu scale, pm-4k6b context engine, pm-96h7 graph, pm-92if quality, pm-k6t4yb gate registry, pm-z71aoy token corpus, pm-ag9nka profile truthfulness); only one non-duplicate focused defect was filed.

All review surfaces are inspected through live CLI inventory and repository gates on current main; every finding is checked against all pm statuses; canonical items receive dated evidence comments; only non-duplicate gaps receive focused items with complete metadata; tracker health, history drift, and duplicate state are verified after the pass; tracker-only changes are committed and pushed directly to main; no product implementation is performed
